title: New Bounds on Distributional Sectional Category and Applications to Distributional Homotopic Distance
summary: In this paper, we establish several new bounds for the distributional sectional category ($\mathrm{dsecat}$). We first prove Jauhari's conjecture, thereby establishing a cohomological lower bound for $\mathrm{dsecat}$ with arbitrary coefficients. We then obtain an analogous lower bound with rational coefficients by constructing a natural splitting of the map induced on cohomology by the diagonal inclusion into symmetric powers.
